description: Controlled vocabulary for classifying AWS Threat Model mitigation statements into canonical security intents. Each pattern matches the mitigation statement text (case-insensitive substring or regex) and assigns a structured intent_id and security_domain. Consumed by map-generate-controls to tag controls, and by map-framework-mapping to constrain objective eligibility.

match_statements: encrypted with an AWS KMS Customer Managed Key
patterns.description: Resource data must be encrypted at rest with a customer-managed KMS key.
Resource must have encryption at rest enabled (any key type).

match_statements: should be in an Amazon VPC
patterns.description: Resource must be placed within a customer VPC for network governance.
Resource must span multiple AZs for availability.
Resource must not be in a public subnet.
Resource must send application/system logs to CloudWatch Logs.

match_statements: SigV4 authentication integrated with AWS IAM
use AWS IAM for inbound authorization
patterns.description: Resource must use IAM-based authentication instead of passwords or unauthenticated access.

match_statements: role should only be assumable by
IAM.*role should only be assumable by.*principal
patterns.description: Execution/service role trust policy must be scoped to the service principal with source conditions.

match_statements: role should be accessed only by trusted identities
IAM.*role should be accessed only by trusted
patterns.description: Execution/service role must be assumable only by authorized principals or services acting on their behalf.

match_statements: resource.*policy should limit permissions to a subset
policy should limit permissions to a subset
policy should be accessed only by trusted
patterns.description: Resource-based policy must restrict access to an approved subset of IAM principals.

match_statements: resource policy should only be accessed by.*service principal
resource.*policy should only be accessed by.*principal when.*acting on behalf
patterns.description: Resource policy must scope service-principal access with source ARN/account/org conditions to prevent confused deputy.

match_statements: should not allow unauthenticated or public access
patterns.description: Resource must not permit unauthenticated or public access.

match_statements: tagged with information that describes the owner and purpose
patterns.description: Resource must carry ownership and purpose tags for governance classification.

match_statements: should not be tagged with personally identifiable information
patterns.description: Tags must not contain PII or sensitive data.

match_statements: require encryption of data in transit
patterns.description: Data in transit must be encrypted using TLS.
Resource must have deletion protection to prevent accidental removal.

match_statements: replicated to at least one other AWS region
patterns.description: Resource data must be replicated cross-region for disaster recovery.

match_statements: OIDC to authenticate principals should be configured with only trusted
patterns.description: OIDC/JWT authorizer must be configured to trust only approved identity providers, audiences, and clients.
Resource must have enhanced monitoring or performance insights enabled.
Deployed code/artifacts must be signed by an approved signing profile.
Event source mapping metrics must be enabled for operational visibility.
Failed events must be captured via dead-letter queue or on-failure destination.

match_statements: EC2 instance type built on the AWS Nitro System
patterns.description: Workload must run on AWS Nitro-based instance types for hardware-level isolation.

match_statements: layer's version policy should not allow unauthenticated
patterns.description: Lambda layer version policy must restrict sharing to approved accounts/organizations.
